name: B10-0587/2025 (S&D) – Continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on repeated attacks by Belarus on Lithuania, including balloons sent into Lithuanian airspace that forced airports to close, and Belarus holding Lithuanian trucks. It condemns these actions, backs Lithuania's right to defend itself, and asks the European Union to respond together with stronger sanctions and better protection of borders and key infrastructure.

- What changes: nothing yet; Parliament asks for stronger EU sanctions and defence measures.
- Who it affects: Lithuania, other EU countries, and people flying or trading near Belarus.
- What happens next: the resolution goes to EU leaders, who decide on any action.
